title: Survey Column
description: An 18 m ivory limestone survey marker with continuous fluting, a cushion capital and a settled masonry footing.

review.notes: Lead extra round (material only): approved. Fixed: the marble-like blotches on the torus are gone; the shaft now carries readable vertical rain streaks running down from the capital and the drum joints (closeup), the capital and abacus have grey-green lichen and grime in the recesses, and the plinth foot is darkened and damp with moss tufts and chips around it (t9). Shape unchanged and still good. Polish (non-blocking): the dark flecks on the lowest drums are small, evenly scattered spots; fewer, larger patches that gather in the flutes would read more natural.
